name: sidecut-agentskills
description: Creates, checks and publishes Sidecut plugins, skills and MCP servers that all follow one house style.

interface.shortDescription: Creates, checks and publishes Sidecut plugins, skills and MCP servers that all follow one house style.
interface.longDescription: Writes new plugin repos from one template, adds skills and MCP tools, and checks every file against the Sidecut house style. It also brings older plugins into that style and publishes them to the Sidecut marketplace.
defaultPrompt: Make a new Sidecut plugin for my release checklist
Check this plugin against the Sidecut house style
Bring my old plugin into the Sidecut house style
